plugins.name: chronograph-gp
plugins.description: Portfolio monitoring, valuations, and analytics for private capital GP teams. Portfolio-company one-pagers, fund quarterly review packs, markup/markdown briefs, TVPI attribution, and budget-vs-actuals against your Chronograph data.

skills.name: chronograph-budget-vs-actuals-variance
skills.description: Compare portfolio company operating actuals against budget/plan, compute variances, flag off-plan companies, and roll up to the fund, using Chronograph company metrics.
headings: Scenarios — how budget and actuals are distinguished
skills.name_hint: chronograph · 预算 · vs · actuals · variance

skills.name: chronograph-fund-quarterly-review-pack
skills.description: Generate a consolidated quarterly review pack for a single fund — a fund-level summary plus a one-pager section for every portfolio company in the fund — using Chronograph data.
skills.name_hint: chronograph · fund · quarterly · 评审 · pack

skills.name: chronograph-markup-markdown-brief
skills.description: Identify which portfolio companies were marked up or down this period, quantify each change, surface the stated basis, and rank by impact on fund NAV — using Chronograph investment metrics.

skills.name: chronograph-portfolio-company-one-pager
skills.description: Generate one-pagers and investor reports for private equity portfolio companies. Handles live data fetching via the Chronograph MCP OR an uploaded Excel model, metric formatting, AI-generated or model-sourced commentary, and rendering a fully styled HTML one-pager.
headings: Step 2 — Resolve the Company & Fetch Data

skills.name: chronograph-tvpi-attribution-by-company
skills.description: Decompose a fund's total value / TVPI into per-company contributions, split realized vs. unrealized, and rank top contributors and detractors — using Chronograph investment metrics.

headings: Before you install: add the Chronograph connector
